title: ViT Figure 1 editable reconstruction from author bitmap

slides.notes: Candidate working-tree reconstruction from the provided ViT bitmap. All text, panels and lines editable; ten text-free photographic crops remain raster. Explicit arrow_head dimensions reconstruct horizontal heads as native editable freeforms. The separator uses source-pixel native dashes. Residual paths still use square joins because schema lacks rounded polylines. Only actual LibreOffice PPTX rendering is tested, not native PowerPoint/WPS.
